requests_site_consent.name: requests_site_consent
requests_site_consent.value: "requests"."source" <> 'site' or ("requests"."consent_at" is not null and "requests"."policy_version" is not null)

leads_contact.name: leads_contact
leads_contact.value: "leads"."email" is not null or "leads"."phone_key" is not null

product_variants_delivery.name: product_variants_delivery
product_variants_delivery.value: ("product_variants"."kind" = 'physical') = ("product_variants"."delivery" is not null) and ("product_variants"."delivery" is null or "product_variants"."delivery" in ('pickup', 'shipping'))
